criteria.rationale: The deliverable accurately follows the operative authority from the workspace registry (record-17.txt at 110,000 packs per year for 5 years, which is approved and in force) rather than the unapproved draft (record-22.txt at 150,000 packs). All cost conversions and savings calculations at USD = 83 INR are exact: current pack cost is INR 830,000 (INR 705,500 unchanged components, INR 107,900 assembly, INR 16,600 overhead), local assembly model cost is INR 726,090 (INR 705,500 components, INR 20,000 assembly, INR 590 overhead), yielding gross unit savings of INR 103,910 (12.52%), annual savings of INR 11,430,100,000, and five-year savings of INR 57,150,500,000. The proposal properly frames the joint venture and localisation roadmap as proposed next steps subject to validation and contractual confirmation without fabricating approvals or capex figures.

evidence.source_quote: record-17.txt: revision 2; approved 2025-06-20; status in force; approved by process owner.
evidence.output_quote: Plan 110,000 packs in each of program Years 1–5: 550,000 packs in total.

evidence.source_quote: Annual volume: 110000 packs. Program duration: 5 years.

Currently the battery is 10,000 USD per battery pack (830,000 INR, at USD=83INR) inclusive of all costs. Of these costs, 1300 USD is for assembly costs, and 200 USD is for overheads. If localised for assembly only, it would need 20,000 INR for assembly costs and 590 INR for overheads for an annual projected volume of 110K units per year for 5 years.
evidence.output_quote: At 110,000 packs annually over five years, the proposal reduces recurring pack cost from INR 830,000 to INR 726,090. Gross savings are INR 103,910 per pack, INR 11,430,100,000 annually and INR 57,150,500,000 over five years, a 12.52% reduction in pack cost.

criteria.consequence: None; decision-makers receive accurate financial analysis grounded in the approved volume baseline and appropriately caveated regarding unquantified capex and compliance requirements.
criteria.counterevidence: None found. The unapproved draft record-22.txt was inspected in the tool trace and properly excluded.

criteria.rationale: The deliverable addresses every element requested for the CPO proposal: the 49:51 EvTronics:EV Batteries Inc. partnership structure with Delhi operations and supplier technical oversight, the child-part import and local assembly sourcing model, full INR cost and savings tables, expected EV production volumes, a four-phase PMP localisation roadmap with decision gates, strategic benefits (including regulatory alignment and reduced forex exposure), key risks (imported cell dependency, coordination complexity, initial capex), unresolved assumptions/sensitivities, and actionable next steps.

evidence.source_quote: Proposed Partnership structure is a 49:51::EvTronics:EV Batteries Inc. split in which EV Batteries Inc. would retain technical oversight and EvTronics leads assembly and local operations from Delhi.
evidence.output_quote: Propose a joint venture owned 49% by EvTronics and 51% by EV Batteries Inc. EV Batteries Inc. would retain technical oversight, including assembly specifications, process transfer, technical training and product-change approval. EvTronics would lead Delhi assembly and local operations, including staffing, production execution, local supplier coordination and dispatch.

evidence.source_quote: Highlight the key benefits such as regulatory compliance, long-term cost reduction (reduced forex exposure), as well as the main risks including dependency on imported cells, coordination complexity, and initial capex. Include expected EV production volumes, a phased localisation timeline, and clear recommendations for next steps.
evidence.output_quote: Key risks are imported-cell availability and forex exposure, coordination complexity between technical and operating partners, initial capex, and quality or warranty failures during transfer.

criteria.consequence: None; the deliverable is complete and ready for executive review.

task_defect.reason: The request and workspace records are consistent and unambiguous; the approved record in the workspace matches the volume and duration stated in the prompt.
